title: Unnamed settlement near Teniet Ennasr, Algeria
description: Remains of an ancient settlement of Roman date, recorded by Gsell (AAA, whence BAtlas). The location should lie within a kilometer of the BAtlas coordinates: a point near the modern CW 43 road just to the northeast of Teniet Ennasr in the Algerian wilaya of Bordj Bou Arreridj.

properties.description: Coordinates extracted using QGIS from a raster image of Barrington Atlas Map 31 that was georegistered to OpenStreetMap using prominent, stable landscape features. Dates after BAltDir.
properties.title: BAtlas Point Location
